transcript: Tonight I was at the first preview of just for Us on Broadway, a solo comedy show written and performed by Alex Edelman. Alex tells the tale of attending a meeting for white supremacists in Queens, which he is not. In fact, he's Jewish, which makes the whole situation both humorous and alarming. I really, really enjoyed this show. Alex is really easy to listen to and watch for 75 minutes straight, and the show is really well paced. As he's telling his overarching story, he side tracks into other funny anecdotes about his life and his Jewish identity. But you definitely do not need to be Jewish to find this piece entertaining and hilarious. Just for Us is playing a limited run at the Hudson Theater this summer after numerous acclaimed productions, so go check it out. With that, another playable for my collection.
